selection_status: No accepted overall winner. The original 13 user requests are the primary comparison. The higher-cost experimental candidate costs 16.39 times as much on these matched requests; that tradeoff has not been justified or accepted.

request_matching.matching_rule: Exact unchanged request string; original order retained.

cost_basis.original: Captured actual Jev attributes USD + reading USD for each original request. All six original variants reuse these exact interpretations and have the same model cost.
cost_basis.final: Same captured original Jev cost + original uncached Gemini3.1 planner cost + original uncached Gemini3 Flash IDs-v3-minimal reranker cost on that exact request. This is projected model cost per search, not new spend incurred by this offline audit.
cost_basis.excluded_from_both: Database infrastructure, local compute, UI, and unavailable full-catalog vector-fill costs.
cost_basis.ratio: Mean(final projected model cost on13)/mean(original Jev model cost on the same13). Per-request ratios are also shown separately.

timing_basis.baseline_retrieval_only: Prior measured median retrieval time per request/variant from comparison.json; excludes Jev interpretation and eligibility preparation.
timing_basis.baseline_reconstructed_total: max(captured attributes ms, captured reading ms) + prior retrieval median. This reconstruction excludes eligibility preparation and is not measured end-to-end latency.
timing_basis.final_reconstructed_total: max(captured planner + measured new centrality/recall retrieval, captured parallel Jev + max(prior corrected retrieval, prior English-phrase retrieval)) + recorded uncached final reranker time. Reuses frozen upstream measurements; excludes unmeasured eligibility preparation, UI, and startup.
timing_basis.timing_comparison_warning: Retrieval-only and reconstructed pipeline times must not be compared as though they share a basis. All final times here use original13 frozen upstream data, not later optimization/fresh-request timings.
timing_basis.statistic_unit: 13 request-level values. Original retrieval values are medians across prior benchmark repetitions; final reranker values are individual recorded calls.
timing_basis.gated_request_warning: Tiny baseline retrieval times can mean the lexical branch was gated/skipped. No full-catalog vector fill was run. These are not claims of complete successful search at near-zero latency; per-case gated flags and candidate counts are preserved.
